From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

(Redirected from [35 mm film](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=35_mm_film&redirect=no "35 mm film"))

**35 mm** may refer to:

## Film

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=35_mm&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Film")]

*   [135 film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/135_film "135 film"), a type of still photography format commonly referred to as "35 mm film"
*   [35 mm movie film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/35_mm_movie_film "35 mm movie film"), a type of motion picture film stock
*   [35MM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ryan_Scott_Oliver#35MM "Ryan Scott Oliver"), a "musical exhibition" by Ryan Scott Oliver that features music played to photos

## Military

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=35_mm&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Military")]

*   [Oerlikon GDF](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oerlikon_GDF "Oerlikon GDF"), a 35 mm anti-aircraft cannon
